entries.title: II Samuel 1:1
segments: And it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

entries.title: II Samuel 1:2
segments: it came to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:3
segments: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:4
segments: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, The people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:5
segments: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?

entries.title: II Samuel 1:6
segments: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and the horsemen followed hard after him.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:7
segments: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:8
segments: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:9
segments: And he said unto me, Stand, I pray thee, beside me, and slay me; for anguish hath taken hold of me, because my life is yet whole in me.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:10
segments: So I stood beside him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:11
segments: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

entries.title: II Samuel 1:12
segments: and they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Jehovah, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:13
segments: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a sojourner, an Amalekite.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:14
segments: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to put forth thy hand to destroy Jehovah's anointed?

entries.title: II Samuel 1:15
segments: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him, so that he died.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:16
segments: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain Jehovah's anointed.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:17
segments: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

entries.title: II Samuel 1:18
segments: (and he bade them teach the children of Judah [the song of] the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

entries.title: II Samuel 1:19
segments: Thy glory, O Israel, is slain upon thy high places! How are the mighty fallen!

entries.title: II Samuel 1:20
segments: Tell it not in Gath, Publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon; Lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, Lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:21
segments: Ye mountains of Gilboa, Let there be no dew nor rain upon you, neither fields of offerings: For there the shield of the mighty was vilely cast away, The shield of Saul, not anointed with oil.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:22
segments: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, The bow of Jonathan turned not back, And the sword of Saul returned not empty.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:23
segments: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, And in their death they were not divided: They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than lions.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:24
segments: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, Who clothed you in scarlet delicately, Who put ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:25
segments: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan is slain upon thy high places.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:26
segments: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: Very pleasant hast thou been unto me: Thy love to me was wonderful, Passing the love of women.

entries.title: II Samuel 1:27
segments: How are the mighty fallen, And the weapons of war perished!
